capsuleTopic.orientation: Do not begin with a single definition and force every covenant passage into it. Follow the biblical word and its close promise-language through different people, events, signs, ceremonies, failures, renewals, prophetic hopes, meals, and later arguments. Some scenes explicitly say covenant; others are included because later Scripture itself remembers the earlier promise as covenantal.
capsuleTopic.trailPrompt: Trace covenant as a concept that acquires history. Keep Noah, Abraham, Israel, Moses, David, the prophets, Jesus, and later apostolic writers visible. Notice what changes in parties, signs, obligations, promises, mediators, and literary genre before attempting synthesis.
